title: 第9章 结丹境一手擒之第10章 无极剑体奶妈求助
slug: 九脉被夺我以魔种证无敌
lines: 秦逸体内的魔意，此刻就犹如沸腾了一般。
意识世界中，魔像都仿佛要冲出来，血海在翻滚，怨魂在尖叫。
秦飞雪朝着秦逸冲去，她手中那迸发出耀眼寒光的下品道剑，弥漫出无比冰冷的气息。
随着秦飞雪的剑招使出。
剑光席卷，竟有一层寒冰朝着秦逸蔓延而去。
秦逸一剑刺入身前的寒冰之中，手腕发力一绞。
“咔嚓！”
“咔嚓！”
这一层寒冰，顿时就浮现了一条条裂痕，然后化作了漫天飞溅的寒冰碎片。
秦飞雪冷哼一声，剑招再变，剑锋搅动，所有的寒冰碎片，被她的力量牵引，化作了一把把细小的冰剑，全部朝着秦逸激射而去。
惊雷剑法，雷盾！
秦逸的身前，一道道冒着雷光的剑气交织，化作了一块仿佛坚不可摧的雷霆盾牌。
秦飞雪那密密麻麻的冰剑，射杀到秦逸的雷霆盾牌前方，便纷纷支离破碎。
秦逸的剑锋掠向秦飞雪。
雷霆盾牌转而化作了一道巨大恢宏的雷霆剑气，发出轰隆隆的雷鸣之声，斩向秦飞雪。
感受到这一道雷霆剑气的威力，秦飞雪终于变了脸色。
她轻喝一声，手中的下品道剑挥出，剑光倾泻，一座虚幻的雪山异象，浮现在了她的身前。
巨大的雷霆剑气，劈在了这座雪山异象的表面。
震耳欲聋的炸响爆发，雪山异象被劈碎，强横的风暴气浪席卷，秦飞雪的身体往后飞退。
她双脚落地，还是无法维持平衡，又连连后退数步。
秦逸眼中，闪过一丝遗憾，只要他与秦飞雪的身体产生直接的碰触，亦或者他的力量能落在秦飞雪的身上，都能引动魔种。
可秦飞雪的身体表面，维持着一层雄浑的罡气。
“想不到，你这些年，竟隐藏的如此之深，难怪我九弟会死在你手里！”
秦飞雪的眼睛微微眯起，目光冰冷。
她身上弥漫而出的寒意更加惊人，周围的空中开始出现飘荡的雪花，脚下的地面则是被厚厚的冰层覆盖。
“何止是秦永那个废物死在我手里？”
秦逸冷喝，道：“你也一样！”
“在你之后，你那些兄长，姐姐，还有你爹你娘，你们这些无耻的狗东西，都得死！”
“大言不惭！”
秦飞雪怒喝，道：“刚才让你占据了一点上风，那只是因为我小觑了你，接下来，我可要认真了！”
“我会让你知道，我的先天剑魂，到底有多么强大！”
秦逸的表情显得扭曲，发出了充斥着浓浓嘲讽之意的讥笑声：“好一个不要脸的贱人，在我面前，也敢说那是你的先天剑魂？”
秦飞雪冷哼一声，道：“先天剑魂就是我的，你能如何？”
“我能如何？我自然会杀了你，夺回属于我的一切！”
秦逸话音落下，再次朝着秦飞雪攻去。
content_en:
The demonic intention in Qin Yi's body seemed to be boiling at this moment.
In the world of consciousness, the demons seem to be rushing out, the sea of ​​blood is rolling, and the resentful souls are screaming.
Qin Feixue rushed towards Qin Yi, and the low-grade Dao sword in her hand emitted a dazzling cold light, filled with an extremely cold aura.
Following Qin Feixue's sword moves.
The sword light swept across, and a layer of ice spread towards Qin Yi.
Qin Yi thrust his sword into the ice in front of him and twisted his wrist.
"Crack!"
"Crack!"
Cracks suddenly appeared in this layer of ice, and then turned into ice fragments flying all over the sky.
Qin Feixue snorted coldly, changed her sword moves again, stirred the sword edge, and all the ice fragments were pulled by her power and turned into small ice swords, all of which shot towards Qin Yi.
Thunder Sword Technique, Thunder Shield!
In front of Qin Yi, streaks of thunderous sword energy intertwined and turned into a seemingly indestructible thunder shield.
Qin Feixue's densely packed ice swords were shot into pieces in front of Qin Yi's thunder shield.
Qin Yi's sword edge swept towards Qin Feixue.
The thunder shield turned into a huge and magnificent thunder sword energy, making a rumbling sound of thunder and slashing towards Qin Feixue.
Feeling the power of this thunder sword energy, Qin Feixue finally changed her expression.
She shouted softly, swung out the low-grade Dao sword in her hand, the sword light poured out, and an illusory snow-capped mountain appeared in front of her.
The huge thunderous sword energy struck the surface of this snow-capped mountain.
"Boom!"
A deafening explosion erupted, the snowy mountain vision was shattered, a powerful storm wave swept across, and Qin Feixue's body flew back.
She landed on her feet, but still couldn't maintain her balance, so she took a few steps back.
A trace of regret flashed in Qin Yi's eyes. As long as he had direct contact with Qin Feixue's body, or his power could fall on Qin Feixue's body, the demon seed could be aroused.
But the surface of Qin Feixue's body maintained a layer of powerful Gang Qi.
"I didn't expect that you have hidden yourself so deeply all these years. No wonder my ninth brother died in your hands!"
Qin Feixue's eyes narrowed slightly, her gaze cold.
The chill that spread over her body was even more astonishing. Snowflakes began to appear in the air around her, and the ground beneath her feet was covered with thick ice.
"It's not just Qin Yong who died in my hands?"
Qin Yi shouted coldly and said, "Same for you!"
"After you, your brothers, sisters, and your father and mother, you shameless bitches, will all die!"
"Shameless talk!"
Qin Feixue shouted angrily, "I gave you a slight advantage just now because I underestimated you. Next time, I'm going to take it seriously!"
"I will let you know how powerful my innate sword soul is!"
Qin Yi's expression looked distorted, and he let out a sneer full of ridicule: "What a shameless bitch, in front of me, how dare you say that is your innate sword soul?"
Qin Feixue snorted coldly and said, "The innate sword soul is mine, what can you do?"
"What can I do? I will naturally kill you and take back everything that belongs to me!"
After Qin Yi finished speaking, he attacked Qin Feixue again.
title_en: Chapter 9: Catch him with one hand in the Dan Formation Realm Chapter 10: The Wuji Sword Body Nanny asks for help
